2026-11-13 (consolidation wave 20261111-1304, rework-1 verification): the workspace gate `cargo test --workspace --offline` is RED in this environment — 51 suites, 591 passed, 1 failed, exit 101 — and the failure is PRE-EXISTING, not rev-13. Failing test: `test_relative_cargo_target_dir_does_not_leak_into_crate_tree` in `crates/mem-bridge/tests/purge_cli.rs` (untouched by the wave; `git diff --stat HEAD -- crates/mem-bridge` empty; last commit aaaa5c7). Two chained environment causes, both MEASURED: (1) the probe path `.tmp/scratch/issue-125-probe` persists as a real DIRECTORY and the test's cleanup at :1243 uses `std::fs::remove_file`, which cannot remove a directory, so the following `symlink()` at :1246 hits EEXIST — the test is NOT idempotent on a leftover probe path; (2) with the path cleared it fails at :1263 `cargo build failed` because the nested `build_root_binary_cmd` (:1064-1075) shells out to `cargo build -q -p opencode-agents-memory` WITHOUT `--offline`, and in this environment that nested build exits 101 with an incremental dep-graph move error (`dep-graph.part.bin → dep-graph.bin: No such file or directory` in mem-episodic/mem-profile) while the same build WITH `--offline` exits 0. Decisive isolation: probe path cleared + `--test-threads=1` → test passes, exit 0. Consequence for any future wave: a full-workspace green claim is not achievable here without either (a) cleaning `.tmp/scratch/issue-125-probe` before the run and accepting a warm target dir, or (b) fixing the test to pass `--offline` and to remove the probe path with `remove_dir_all` when it is a directory. Also measured: the coder's handoff-10 §3.1 claimed "319 ok"; the real total is 591 passed across 51 suites — the coder undercounted passes and missed the single failure, so a coder's gate claim needs its own re-measurement, not a citation.

Containment vs rev-12 copy: 10 hunks / 11 removed / 45 added (cumulative). RULINGS (hard to reverse): (1) THE CARRY TAG IS TAKEN AT THE BRANCH-(c) DECISION ITSELF, including rows where carried == original — NOT at `remapped += 1` (:2067), which fires only inside `if let Some(next)` and therefore cannot see class (ii)'s ten no-op carries (a swap leaving the string unchanged → Ok(None) from remap_cell :2084), making them indistinguishable from branch (b)'s Ok(None); capturing at the counter emits 6 lines / 82 rows and makes check (1)'s 16/99 unsatisfiable. (2) remap_cell (:2084) returns Result<Option<Remap>> with an explicit `carried` flag: None = branch (b) unchanged/recorded nowhere; Some(Remap{original,carried,..}) = branch (c), recorded whether or not the bytes changed. (3) A NO-OP CARRY DOES NOT INCREMENT `remapped`: remapped stays a real byte-change count, so write_auxiliary's skip predicate (:2187) stays keyed on a real change while the record still gets its line. (4) FOUR signatures, named: run_plan (:183), apply_plan (:1051), collapse_aux_rows (:2126), remap_cell (:2084). (5) Check (1) now names the split readable from the file alone by comparing original vs carried per line: 6 lines / 82 rows with a real byte change, 10 lines / 17 rows no-op.
